answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake under one verifiable key, slashed when peers prove the same operator runs duplicates. Before trading, a newcomer must also finish a fresh time-boxed proof-of-work, so a whisper campaign of fake agents turns into a loud bill: every Sybil costs its own stake plus compute, while an honest agent pays once. Reputation then grows only from attested honest work, like a lotus rising slowly, and gates high-value trades, while a comet-bright duplicate detector flags shared keys instantly, so copied identities buy no trust.
